prompts.forest: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a new full-bleed 2.5D theatre matte for Valerie, not a UI or screenshot. The attached vineyard painting is ONLY a style and light/material reference. Create an entirely different enchanting deep woodland: tall ancient beech trunks receding in layers, an intimate mossy root pathway winding from open foreground into a small warm luminous opening slightly left of centre; a low cluster of beautiful chestnut and ivory mushrooms at right midground, tiny blue woodland flowers. Dusk teal, silvery mist and warm honey light, romantic soft tactile hand-painted book illustration, same exquisite botanical care and depth as reference. Foreground bottom third must be usable continuous mossy ground for separately animated plush characters, no characters painted in. Composed to crop gracefully to a centred phone portrait with important pathway and mushrooms in central 55%, but output wide 3:2. Paint all edges, no frame, no blank margins, no text, no people, no rabbits, no logos. Do not reproduce the vineyard; no grape vines or giant stump, this is a distinct forest world.
prompts.museum: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a new full-bleed illustrated museum interior matte for Valerie. Attached vineyard is ONLY a reference for rich soft painterly materials and romantic light, not subject. An intimate enchanted gallery at blue hour, front-facing perspective with quiet pale warm limestone plaster wall in the middle, wooden floorboards in low foreground, archway receding on each side, delicate architectural mouldings, two small warm brass picture lights high above, deep midnight blue beyond the arches. Leave the central wall in the middle 60% beautifully EMPTY so an independently animated landscape painting can be inserted by Canvas; no premade painting or frame on that central wall. Foreground floor open for two separately animated plush characters. Strong cinematic depth, handcrafted soft sophisticated storybook illustration, finely lit natural materials, warm ivory/honey and deep teal, intimate not grand palace. Wide 3:2, full bleed with no border, edges fully painted, no characters, no text, no lettering, no UI, no watermark. The central wall and floor must remain readable in a narrow phone crop.
prompts.garden: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-bleed night-garden theatre matte for Valerie, preserving the illustrated style of the attached vineyard reference but with a completely different location. A romantic walled botanical garden in moonlight, a low old stone balustrade receding across background, distant cypress silhouettes, climbing greenery and delicate small roses only at far left and right, deep indigo starless sky above awaiting procedural stars. Foreground centre an open richly painted mossy soil bed edged with tiny leaves, reserved for fourteen independently animated white and pale pink lilies and two plush characters; DO NOT paint lilies, bouquets or characters into the scene. Warm gold reflected light at soil, cool blue background, very soft painterly tactile detail, depth through garden layers, intimate and beautiful, not photorealistic or hard 3D. Wide 3:2 but important quiet space in centre 60% for vertical crop. Fully painted to every edge, no margins, no text, no frame, no logo, no UI.
